---
name: research-review
description: Review research intended for Independent Research for evidence quality, argument coherence, and limitations. Use for manuscript review rather than website implementation.
---

Read the repository AGENTS.md and establish whether the supplied material is approved for public release. Review private material only in its authorized location; do not copy it into this public repository.

Distinguish empirical claims, interpretation, and proposals. Check whether methods and evidence support the conclusions, whether alternative explanations are addressed, and whether limitations are visible. Verify cited sources when available; identify unverifiable references without fabricating replacements.

Return concrete findings with passage locations, their effect on the argument, and suggested revisions. Separate necessary corrections from optional editorial improvements. Preserve the author's position and state uncertainty. Review does not imply publication approval.
